lat: ddit khuya l l-mdrassa l-bare7
en: I gave my brother a ride to school yesterday.

lat: ma dditsh weld 3mmi l l-khedma
en: I didn't give my cousin a ride to work.

lat: dditi sa7bek l l-m7etta l-bare7
en: You gave your friend a ride to the station yesterday.

lat: ma dditish khtek l d-dar
en: You didn't give your sister a ride home.

lat: dditi bentek l t-tbib l-yum
en: You (f.) gave your daughter a ride to the doctor today.

lat: ma dditish jartna l s-suq
en: You (f.) didn't give our neighbor a ride to the market.

lat: dda bah l l-fermasyan f s-sba7
en: He gave his father a ride to the pharmacy in the morning.

lat: ma ddash sa7bu l l-matar
en: He didn't give his friend a ride to the airport.

lat: ddat mha l l-7emmam l-bare7
en: She gave her mother a ride to the bathhouse yesterday.

lat: ma ddatsh wladha l l-7adiqa
en: She didn't give her children a ride to the park.

lat: ddina l-walidin l d-dar dyalhum
en: We gave the parents a ride to their house.

lat: ma ddinash n-nas l l-mdina
en: We didn't give the people a ride to the city.

lat: dditu d-drari l l-matsh l-bare7
en: You (pl.) gave the kids a ride to the match yesterday.

lat: ma dditush khtkum l l-jami3a
en: You (pl.) didn't give your sister a ride to the university.

lat: ddaw l-walidin l l-3ers
en: They gave the parents a ride to the wedding.

lat: ma ddawsh sh-shabab l l-khedma
en: They didn't give the young men a ride to work.

lat: kanddi benti l l-mdrassa kul sba7
en: I give my daughter a ride to school every morning.

lat: ma kanddish weld jirana l d-dar
en: I don't give our neighbors' son a ride home.

lat: katddi khuya l l-khedma kul yum
en: You give my brother a ride to work every day.

lat: ma katddish sa7bek f t-tumubil dyalek
en: You don't give your friend a ride in your car.

lat: katddi walidik l s-suq kul simana
en: You (f.) give your parents a ride to the market every week.

lat: ma katddish bent 3mmek l l-mdrassa
en: You (f.) don't give your cousin a ride to school.

lat: kayddi khtu l l-bosta kul khemis
en: He gives his sister a ride to the post office every Thursday.

lat: ma kayddish 7ed l l-khedma
en: He doesn't give anyone a ride to work.

lat: katddi mha l l-khedma f s-sba7
en: She gives her mother a ride to work in the morning.

lat: ma katddish d-drari l l-b7er
en: She doesn't give the kids a ride to the beach.

lat: kanddiw sa7bna l l-m7etta kul jem3a
en: We give our friend a ride to the station every Friday.

lat: ma kanddiwsh n-nas b l-flus
en: We don't give people a ride for money.

lat: katddiw wladkum l l-mdrassa dima
en: You (pl.) always give your kids a ride to school.

lat: ma katddiwsh khukum l l-mdrassa
en: You (pl.) don't give your brother a ride to school.

lat: kayddiw l-walidin dyalhum l l-3rubiya
en: They give their parents a ride to the countryside.

lat: ma kayddiwsh jeddhum l l-jame3
en: They don't give their grandfather a ride to the mosque.

lat: ghadi nddi khalti l s-sbitar ghedda
en: I'm going to give my aunt a ride to the hospital tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish nddi weld khalti l l-matar
ar: ما غاديش ندي ولد خالتي للمطار
en: I'm not going to give my cousin a ride to the airport.

lat: ghadi tddi khuya l l-m7etta l-yum
en: You are going to give my brother a ride to the station today.

lat: ma ghadish tddi sa7bek m3ak l-lila
ar: ما غاديش تدي صاحبك معاك الليلة
en: You are not going to take your friend with you tonight.

lat: ghadi tddi khtek l l-maktaba ghedda
en: You (f.) are going to give your sister a ride to the library tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish tddi bentek l d-dar daba
ar: ما غاديش تدي بنتك للدار دابا
en: You (f.) are not going to give your daughter a ride home now.

lat: ghadi yddi bah l l-banka f l-3shiya
en: He is going to give his father a ride to the bank in the afternoon.

lat: ma ghadish yddi jeddatu l s-suq
en: He is not going to give his grandmother a ride to the market.

lat: ghadi tddi khti l l-markaz ghedda
en: She is going to give my sister a ride to the center tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish tddi d-drari l l-b7er l-yum
ar: ما غاديش تدي الدراري للبحر اليوم
en: She is not going to give the kids a ride to the beach today.

lat: ghadi nddiw 3emmi l l-matar f l-lil
en: We are going to give my uncle a ride to the airport at night.

lat: ma ghadish nddiw l-jiran l l-mdina
en: We are not going to give the neighbors a ride to the city.

lat: ghadi tddiw khtkum l l-khedma ghedda
en: You (pl.) are going to give your sister a ride to work tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish tddiw weldkum l l-matsh
en: You (pl.) are not going to give your son a ride to the match.

lat: ghadi yddiw l-walidin l l-qehwa daba
en: They are going to give the parents a ride to the cafe now.

lat: ma ghadish yddiw sa7bhum l l-mdrassa
en: They are not going to give their friend a ride to school.
